title: apkg-tools: read and write Anki .apkg / .colpkg files in JavaScript
description:
Read and write Anki .apkg / .colpkg packages and convert them to and from CSV, in the browser and in Node.js, with no Anki install; files never leave the device.

apkg-tools is the conversion core behind GuruOwl's free in-browser Anki tools, including the APKG viewer at https://guruowl.com/apkg-viewer.
